items.title: Write the Koala-to-Lattice role naming execution document
items.context: Capture inventory, canonical rename map, compatibility boundary, affected template/runtime/doc/test surfaces, and verification commands before changing the role IDs.
items.userSees: The user can open docs/requirements/decisions/koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md and see the inventory, rename map, boundary, rollout steps, and verification commands for the Koala-to-Lattice role migration.

happy.desc: Execution document lists every canonical active koala-* role ID and its lattice-* replacement.

edge.desc: Document distinguishes active role IDs from legacy runtime/archive compatibility strings such as KOALA_* or .koala references.

adversarial.desc: Document does not claim all Koala tokens are gone when intentionally preserved historical/runtime compatibility references remain.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'Active vs Legacy Boundary|Explicit Non-Goals|KOALA_\*|\.koala|hash salts|signed artifact' docs/requirements/decisions/koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Execution plan explicitly separates active role cleanup from legacy runtime/archive compatibility, .koala paths, KOALA_* envs, and signed salts.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'not a global removal|documented exception|legacy/archive/signed-artifact exception|Do not rewrite archive docs' docs/requirements/decisions/koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Execution plan says the story is not a blind removal of every Koala token and documents permitted historical/runtime/signed-artifact exceptions.
Execution plan contains the canonical old-to-new role map for implementer, reviewer, and evaluator IDs.

items.title: Rename canonical agent templates and mirrored host assets from koala-* to lattice-*
items.context: Template filenames, frontmatter names, prompt prose, .claude agent assets, and .Codex agent assets must share the same Lattice role IDs so regenerated assets do not reintroduce Koala names.
items.userSees: Terminal search prints no active Koala agent filenames: `find packages/main/templates/agents .claude/agents .Codex/agents -maxdepth 1 -type f | rg koala-` exits with no matches.

happy.desc: Canonical template files and mirrored .claude/.Codex assets use lattice-* filenames and frontmatter names.

edge.desc: Product-reviewer, implementation-reviewer, test-intent, and test-case-reviewer assets remain correctly named and are not accidentally converted.

adversarial.desc: A search of active template and mirrored agent directories does not find koala-* role IDs after the rename.

verificationEvidence.note: Command exited 1 with no output, so active agent filenames no longer use koala-* in the template or mirrored host asset directories.
All 12 unrelated agent asset filenames remain present across packages/main/templates/agents, .claude/agents, and .Codex/agents.
Command exited 1 with no output, so active koala implementer/review/evaluator role IDs are absent from active agent prompt directories.

items.title: Update CLI runtime role dispatch, schemas, attribution, and help text to Lattice naming
items.context: story_dispatch defaults, reviewer requirement maps, command schemas, commit author fallback, review/pass/finding guidance, and visible help text must stop emitting koala-* identifiers. Legacy koala role aliases should be deleted unless needed only for read-only historical metadata.
items.userSees: Lattice CLI help and workflow hints refer to lattice-implementer and lattice-review-* role IDs, and review/finding/runtime checks accept the lattice reviewer prefix as canonical.

happy.desc: CLI schemas, defaults, help text, dispatch prompts, and review attribution use lattice-* role IDs.

edge.desc: Historical metadata compatibility remains readable only where explicitly documented, without reintroducing active koala-* aliases.

adversarial.desc: review_run_start/finding_add/review_pass_set reject stale koala-review-* active role usage once lattice-* is canonical.

verificationEvidence.command: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && node packages/main/dist/cli.js help | rg 'lattice-(implementer|review|evaluator)'
verificationEvidence.note: Process fact contract passed and local CLI help exposes canonical lattice role lanes without koala role guidance.

verificationEvidence.command: rg focused scan with execution-plan and signed-salt exceptions
verificationEvidence.note: Focused scan shows active surfaces are clean; remaining koala-review matches are signed artifact salts or the execution-plan old-to-new map documented as exceptions.
Legacy koala role dispatch fails fast with a legacy-role rejection, so stale koala active role usage is not accepted as canonical evidence.

items.title: Update documentation, audits, and tests so active surfaces no longer teach Koala naming
items.context: Active docs should teach lattice-* role IDs; legacy archived docs can remain only when explicitly marked historical. Tests and verifier snapshots should assert the Lattice naming surface.
items.userSees: Active documentation and tests teach Lattice role IDs; any remaining Koala references are explicitly historical, runtime-compatibility, or archive material rather than current role guidance.

happy.desc: Active docs and tests that mention agent role IDs use lattice-* names.

edge.desc: Archived Koala docs under legacy paths are not rewritten unless needed to label them as historical.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not instruct users to invoke koala-implementer or koala-review-* for new Lattice work.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n --hidden --glob '!docs/story/**' --glob '!tests/fixtures/**' --glob '!.omx/**' --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!.worktrees/**' --glob '!packages/main/dist/**' --glob '!packages/main/node_modules/**' --glob '!docs/koala/**' --glob '!docs/requirements/decisions/koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md' '\bkoala-(implementer|review|evaluator)|koala_metadata|koala-verifier|Koala Smoke|koala-owned|koala-metadata' CLAUDE.md README.md docs/requirements docs/audits packages/main/src/tasks packages/main/templates .claude .Codex
verificationEvidence.note: Command exited 1 with no output, so active docs, tests, templates, and mirrored host assets no longer teach old koala role IDs or active Koala-branded verifier/metadata vocabulary.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol
verificationEvidence.note: Flow stability and validation protocol smokes passed after preserving archive/signed-artifact boundaries while moving active surfaces to Lattice naming.
TypeScript build passed after docs/tests/runtime vocabulary updates, proving active references compile with lattice role IDs, lattice_metadata_changes, and lattice-verifier provider names.

items.title: Verify no active CLI/template/runtime surface still emits Koala role IDs
items.context: Run targeted rg inventory, CLI help/version checks, unit/build tests, and Codex adapter verification if host agent assets changed.
items.userSees: Verification output shows build/test/Codex adapter checks passing and targeted rg scans show no active koala-* role IDs in CLI help, templates, mirrored host assets, or active documentation.

happy.desc: npm build/test and node bin/lattice.js verify_codex pass after the rename.

edge.desc: Targeted rg scans separate active role IDs from permitted historical/runtime compatibility references.

adversarial.desc: lattice help and dispatch-related help do not emit koala-* role guidance after rebuild.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs && node bin/lattice.js verify_codex
verificationEvidence.note: Build, process/runtime fact contracts, and Codex adapter verification passed; verify_codex reported 8/8 checks passing after host asset rename.

verificationEvidence.command: rg focused active-surface scan plus signed-salt review
verificationEvidence.note: Targeted active scan found no active koala role IDs, koala_metadata, koala-verifier, Koala Smoke, koala-owned, or koala-metadata in docs/templates/tasks/verifier/help surfaces. Remaining focused hits are old signed artifact salts and this execution plan old-to-new map, both documented exceptions.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js help | rg 'koala-(implementer|review|evaluator)|koala-verifier|koala_metadata' && node bin/lattice.js validate --channel --story=B-ffa2
verificationEvidence.note: Help scan exited 1 with no output for old role/verifier/metadata guidance, and channel validation passed with all CHK covered by structured dispatch/subagent_result evidence.
